cohort: The cohort consisted of preterm infants born at or before 34 weeks gestational age, divided into a group with prenatal opioid exposure (n=47) and a matched non-exposed group (n=62).
finding: Preterm infants with prenatal opioid exposure had smaller brain sizes, specifically in several key measurements including ventricular indices, basal ganglia insula, corpus callosum fastigium length, intracranial height index, and transcerebellar measurements, compared to non-exposed infants.
